profile_md: Bath's relevant provision is distributed and mostly postgraduate. The University-wide Vertically Integrated Projects (250 students in 11 interdisciplinary teams in 2025/26, open to UG, PG and doctoral students, largely extracurricular) are group research projects, but external organisations only 'may' contribute, so the employer criterion is unclear. In Engineering & Design, the MEng Group Design and Business Project has third-year teams working about 14 weeks on company-supplied briefs (Airbus, NCC, UKAEA and others named) and presenting to the company, but compulsory status, credit, and current-year delivery were not verified. In the School of Management, MSc Practice Track (teams with an external client, 7-8 weeks in summer, optional) and a six-week MSc Consulting Project with a local organisation are team client projects; the postgraduate consultancy option in several other MSc/MA courses can be done alone or in a group. A short employer-set Big Team Challenge and the student-run 180 Degrees Consulting are also recorded. Most pages are undated (some link to 2027 entry), so current delivery is largely unconfirmed. No science or arts-led qualifying scheme was verified.
gaps: Dated 2025/26-2026/27 delivery for S2-S7; MBA Multi-Project Suite page; unit credit for MEng GDBP; Big Team Challenge page text; further departmental instances (Education MA, IR MSc, Sport Management) likely; no direct page text beyond ~7 fetches.
